cardEffects:
[Hand] [Main] By paying 4 cost and placing this card as 1 of your level 5 or higher Digimon's bottom digivolution card, you may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon and attack an opponent's Digimon with the Digimon this was placed under.
＜Alliance＞ (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, add the suspended Digimon's DP to this Digimon and it gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the attack.)
[End of Attack] You may place this Digimon as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your other Digimon.
inheritedEffect:
[All Turns] When an opponent's effect would delete this Digimon, you may play 1 [Parasitemon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] This Digimon gets +3000 DP.
name: Parasitemon

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  The activation conditions include paying 4 cost and placing this card as 1 of your level 5 or higher Digimon's bottom digivolution card, therefore the effect can't be activated just by paying 4 cost.
rulings.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to pay 4 cost even when I don't have any level 5 or higher Digimon?

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  You must choose to suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon and attack, or you must choose to not suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon and not attack.
rulings.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to place this card as 1 of my level 5 or higher Digimon's bottom digivolution card and suspend 1 of my opponent's Digimon without attacking?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  However, if this card is played before the effect activates, this card's [All Turns] inherited effect can no longer be activated.
rulings.question: If my Digimon with multiples of this card in its digivolution cards would be deleted, can I use this card's [All Turns] inherited effect to play multiples of [Parasitemon]?
